player_prompt.intro:
Wo reko Minesweeper agoro no.
Agoro no botae ne sɛ wo bɛ kyerɛ cells nyinaa a na mino nni mu.
Sɛ wo pɛ sɛ wo yɛ kwan, kyerɛ row ne column nkyekyɛmu a wo pɛ sɛ wo kyerɛ no ase, fa mfoni:
- `[row col]`: Kye cell a ɛwɔ row ne column a wo kyerɛe no.
Sɛ nhwɛso:
- `[3 2]` sɛ wo pɛ sɛ wo kye cell a ɛwɔ Row 3, Column 2.
- `[5 6]` sɛ wo pɛ sɛ wo kye cell a ɛwɔ Row 5, Column 6.
Wo kwan a edi kan no, wo bɛ kye asaase a atwa cell a wo ayɛ no ho sɛnea ɛbɛ yɛ afehyia.
Board a ɛwɔ hɔ nnɛ no mfoni wɔ ase ha. Cells a na wɔnakyere no yɛ nukta ('.'), nkyerɛkyerɛmu a wɔakyere no kyerɛ mino a ɛne no bɔ.
Hwɛ sɛ wo nnkyerɛ cells a wɔakyere dedaw no.
Board a ɛwɔ hɔ nnɛ no mfoni ni:

invalid_move.wrong_format: W'ankasa mfa ntini a ɛwɔ ɔfã biara mu no ho mmuae mma.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Nkyerεkyerεmu a wɔayi no adi wͻ ɔfã ne afidie so no nni nsunsuansoɔ.
invalid_move.already_revealed: Cell no wɔ ({row}, {col}) ade yɛ revealed.

outcome.win: Mo ani agye! Moadi nkonim ama Minesweeper no adi dwuma yiye.
outcome.turn_limit: Wɔadu ɛdan no ano. Woayi nkwammoaa a ahobammɔ wom {percent}% adi yiye.
